title: A proper map of spaces quasi-finite over one point is finite on a neighbourhood of that point
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y proper between spaces over S and y in |Y| with f quasi-finite at every x over y, some open neighbourhood V of y has f^{-1}(V) -> V finite. The retained proof: the quasi-finite locus U subset X is open (Morphisms of Spaces, locally-finite-type-quasi-finite-part); Z = X \ U is closed under the proper map, so f(Z) is closed and misses y; any open V through y disjoint from f(Z) restricts f to a proper, locally quasi-finite map, finite by the in-source characterize-finite lemma (this pool's L16208). Retained author proof at lines 7918-7928.
